properties.description:
Planned 2026-10-21 on Anthony's word ("Go with recommendations. This seems like a fair amount of work, so maybe start another reflow2 epoch/increment to capture this work"), from hxm_program's hub feedback of 2026-10-20: a one-person hub of 15 local designs (3,174 nodes) where organisation policy blocks MCP, so only `reflow2 read|write` (--call) is available and every hub feature built for a hosted gateway is out of reach.
ORDER (one reflow2 PR at a time, the one-PR design hold):
1. A small PR: an import says what it removed and merges only when asked (the data-loss fault, item 5); a local hub's search names the pinned designs it did not search; the hub check shows each member's reviewed revision (item 6); a link into a pinned design says when its record is gone (item 4, the small half).
2. One search reaches the hub and every design it pins, read from their committed exports, and a read can be aimed at a member's export (item 1, req:one-search-reaches-every-design-a-hub-tracks, accepted 2026-09-28).
3. One composed check over the hub and several of its designs (item 2).
4. Designs shown where they already touch, on exact evidence only (item 3).
CONSIDERED, NOT KEPT: a per-machine address book of member stores (item 7, dec:idea-a-hub-on-one-machine-can-say-where-each-tracked-design-is-reached-from-the-door stays proposed); look again after step 2 ships.
WHEN: after flo2.io moves to 0.90.0 (flo2 #174), and before step 6 of epoch:planned-reasoning-build-list (the capstone demo), because hxm_program uses a local hub daily. A release follows; flo2.io follows the release. Session: https://claude.ai/code/session_019Xbw6PG9mXJiU2Sb421fnq
properties.name: Phase 7: a hub on one machine, through the --call door, gets what a hosted hub has
